title: Reading — Labels, a Form, and the Same Facts as Sentences
label: ch:pa-pehla-paath
canDo: I can read a Punjabi form label cold, read a form somebody else filled in, and follow a short paragraph without translating word by word.

payoff.summary: The six facts of a form said again as sentences, so the colon the form leans on is replaced by the ਹੈ Punjabi puts last.
